about_the_game: Scouts Out is a 2D infinite side-scrolling action game that immerses players in the intense world of physics based aerial combat. Players take control of iconic Cavalry helicopters, navigating a variety of modern landscapes while facing waves of enemy threats. The objective is to cover as much distance as possible, skillfully destroying enemies to earn points and secure your position on the leaderboards.

short_description: In this thrilling 2D infinite side-scrolling action game, players take control of agile scout helicopters, navigating treacherous skies filled with relentless enemies. These Pilots must dodge incoming fire while unleashing a barrage of powerful weaponry to obliterate waves of adversaries.
